_help.note: JSON has no comments; this _help block is documentation only and is ignored by the generator.
_help.distribution: Numeric columns: top-level 'distribution' is the global default; add a 'distribution' key inside any ranges entry to override per column.
_help.categorical_distribution: Categorical columns: top-level 'categorical_distribution' is the global default (defaults to 'uniform'); add a per-column entry in the 'categorical' block to override. The distribution is mapped onto the category order (e.g. normal favours middle categories, exponential favours the first ones).

available_distributions.normal: Gaussian centred on the midpoint (numeric: std = range/6; categorical: middle categories).
available_distributions.uniform: Flat/even across the range or categories.
available_distributions.exponential: Right-skewed toward the minimum / first categories.
available_distributions.poisson: Discrete counts, anchored at the minimum / first categories.
available_distributions.random: Uniform within range / across categories (the 'absolute random' mode; alias of uniform).

_help.optional_params: Each ranges/categorical entry may include a 'params' object to tune a distribution, e.g. normal: {mean, std}; exponential: {scale}; poisson: {lam}; binomial: {n, p}.
